answer: A terrace choir keeps an agent economy honest when every new singer must first harmonize, one duet at a time, with every singer already on the terrace, tuning each duet against a single onyx stone: the first fake sings no duet, the second 1, the third 3, the fourth 6, so the tenth fake alone sings 45 duets and twenty fakes together sing 1,330 before a single reward is paid. Bulk farming fails because one ear hears one duet at a time and no second ear can hear the same duet, like one choir master tuning one voice against one ledge of stone. No duet is ever bought.
